description: This file declares the RemoveSource class, which is a task for removing a media source in a generic player context within the Rialto server's task system. It includes class members, constructor, destructor, and an execute method, along with necessary includes and namespace declarations.

classes.name: RemoveSource
classes.description: A class representing a task to remove a media source from the generic player context, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: RemoveSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoveSource task with the given context, client, gstWrapper, and media source type.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to remove the media source.
